required_capabilities: Move Element (×1); Inspect Project (×1); Check Clash (×1)
instruction: The project opens in a 3D view. The window near (1898, 12356) is wrongly placed and clashes with other elements. Repair it: keep its type and size, and move it so no opening clashes with anything. Do not modify any walls, and leave every other opening untouched. Two further windows, near (1898, 9081) and (4403, 12389), have their head above the wall top; lower their sills so they fit inside the wall.
